title: Register a valid student account, then log in with it
description: RF01+RF02. The ONLY successful registration of the whole run. Registers a unique @soyudemedellin.edu.co account, sees the success screen, goes to sign-in and logs in with the same credentials.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the registration tab (Registrarse)
Fill in the full name field with Prueba TestSprite
Fill in the institutional email field with testsprite.rf01.202610252200@soyudemedellin.edu.co
Verify the live hint says the user will enter as ESTUDIANTE and does not say 'no es institucional'
Fill in the identity document field with 9000000001
Submit the registration form (Crear cuenta)
Verify the text '¡Registro exitoso!' is visible
Click 'Ir a iniciar sesión'
Verify the sign-in form is displayed with an empty email field
Fill in the email field with testsprite.rf01.202610252200@soyudemedellin.edu.co
Fill in the identity document field with 9000000001
Submit the login form (Ingresar)
Verify the sign-in form is no longer displayed and the user name 'Prueba TestSprite' or the student home is visible

title: Log in with the existing student account
description: RF02 success case with the seeded student account (laura.est@soyudemedellin.edu.co / 1000000003).

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the email field with laura.est@soyudemedellin.edu.co
Fill in the identity document field with 1000000003
Submit the login form (Ingresar)
Verify the sign-in form is no longer displayed
Verify the name 'Laura Estudiante' or the student home is visible

title: Wrong identity document for a registered email shows the exact error
description: RF02 negative. Uses the real registered email with a wrong document. ONE attempt only (5 failures lock the email for 15 minutes).

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the email field with laura.est@soyudemedellin.edu.co
Fill in the identity document field with 1000000009
Submit the login form (Ingresar)
Verify the exact text 'Correo o documento de identidad incorrectos.' is visible
Verify the sign-in form is still displayed

title: Unregistered email shows the exact error
description: RF02 negative. Email that does not exist in the system.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the email field with noexiste.testsprite@soyudemedellin.edu.co
Fill in the identity document field with 1000000099
Submit the login form (Ingresar)
Verify the exact text 'Correo o documento de identidad incorrectos.' is visible
Verify the sign-in form is still displayed

title: Reject a gmail email during registration
description: RF01 negative. gmail.com is not institutional: live hint and rejection on submit.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the registration tab (Registrarse)
Fill in the full name field with Prueba Gmail
Fill in the institutional email field with prueba.gmail@gmail.com
Verify the text 'Ese dominio no es institucional' is visible
Fill in the identity document field with 9000000002
Submit the registration form (Crear cuenta)
Verify an error containing 'correo institucional' is visible
Verify the text '¡Registro exitoso!' is NOT visible

title: Reject an already registered email during registration
description: RF01 negative. Uses the existing seeded email (no new account is created). Document is different from the existing one on purpose.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the registration tab (Registrarse)
Fill in the full name field with Duplicado Prueba
Fill in the institutional email field with laura.est@soyudemedellin.edu.co
Fill in the identity document field with 9000000003
Submit the registration form (Crear cuenta)
Verify the exact text 'Ya existe una cuenta con este correo.' is visible
Verify the text '¡Registro exitoso!' is NOT visible

title: Live hint shows the student role for a valid institutional email
description: RF01. Only types, does not submit, so no account is created.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the registration tab (Registrarse)
Fill in the institutional email field with carlos.hint@soyudemedellin.edu.co
Verify the text 'Entrarás como ESTUDIANTE' is visible
Verify the text 'no es institucional' is NOT visible

title: Reject an identity document shorter than ten digits
description: RF01 negative. 9 digits is accepted by the input (maxLength 10) but the server must reject it.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the registration tab (Registrarse)
Fill in the full name field with Prueba Documento Corto
Fill in the institutional email field with testsprite.shortdoc@soyudemedellin.edu.co
Fill in the identity document field with 678901234
Submit the registration form (Crear cuenta)
Verify the error 'El documento de identidad debe tener exactamente 10 dígitos.' is visible
Verify the text '¡Registro exitoso!' is NOT visible

title: Login with the document left empty is rejected
description: RF02 negative. Email filled, document empty.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the email field with noexiste.vacio@soyudemedellin.edu.co
Leave the identity document field empty
Submit the login form (Ingresar)
Verify an error message is visible
Verify the sign-in form is still displayed

title: Letters typed in the identity document are discarded
description: RF01. Types letters and digits and checks that only digits remain. Does not submit, so no account is created.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the registration tab (Registrarse)
Type '12a34b567c890' into the identity document field (type it character by character)
Verify the identity document field value is exactly '1234567890' (digits only, no letters)
